name: car_hull
prompt: A four-wheeled off-road racing car with four wheels, one at each corner of a wide flat rectangular chassis. Front-left wheel, front-right wheel, rear-left wheel, rear-right wheel. It is a car, not a motorcycle and not a bicycle. Seen in three-quarter view, sitting level on level ground, nose pointing forward along its length. Wide low body roughly twice as long as it is wide, a flat sloping bonnet over the front axle, two seats side by side in an open cockpit with no doors and no roof, a simple tubular roll bar behind the seats, and a small engine cover at the rear. Chunky treaded tyres. Stocky and purposeful, like a dune buggy or a rally car with its panels stripped off.
texture_prompt: creamy pale butter-yellow painted bodywork with a soft satin sheen, dark grey steel roll bar, matte black rubber tyres, light scuffing and road dirt along the lower edges
